overview: You added a postscript to Sunday's sheet, which has not yet gone. You asked whether the frame in Chapel Street is truly finished, and what the plasterer asked. You wrote that rebuilt can hide a deal of work still owing.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the postscript on the sheet that waits for Thursday.

parties.name: Anne Shakespeare
parties.context: Was not in the room. The question is for her.

summary: Asked if the Chapel Street frame is finished
